text: なさけない　うられた　ケンカに　まけた

structure.jp: うられた　ケンカに　まけた
structure.en: I lost a fight that was picked with me

patterns.name: 〜られる (passive)
patterns.explanation: This verb ending says the thing was done to you by someone else. ケンカをうる is 'to pick a fight', so うられた = 'was picked with me'.

patterns.name: verb + noun
patterns.explanation: A verb placed right before a thing describes that thing. うられた　ケンカ = 'a fight that someone picked with me'.

patterns.name: 〜にまける
patterns.explanation: With まける, に shows what you lost at or who you lost to. ケンカに　まけた = 'I lost the fight'.
